_description: qutebrowser bookmarks — SECTION source of truth for the dashboard start page (Icons + List views) AND flattened `Folder/name` quickmarks. Model: sections[] → each has direct `links` and/or `folders[]` → each folder has `links`. DATA-DRIVEN sources resolved by gen-dashboard.sh: section source:"history" → last 5 from qutebrowser history.sqlite (merged live with localStorage clicks); section source:"front" → one folder per front git category (a-/b-/c-) from front-topology.json; folder source:"cloud:public"|"cloud:app" → services from cloud-data build-flakes_desktop.json (wg_only split). Hand-curated links live inline here. Edit this file (or the cloud/front SoTs); never edit generated qute-bookmarks.html. Order = array order.

sections.name: Last Sessions
sections._note: source:history bakes last-5 from history.sqlite AT BUILD TIME, but sqlite3 is absent in CI (and CI never has your history.sqlite), so the baked part is empty in shipped bundles — the dashboard JS merges LIVE recents from localStorage (bm-recent, dashboard-link clicks) on top. The static 'Full History' link always points at qutebrowser's real qute://history so this section is never empty and real history is one click away.

sections.name: Cloud
sections._note: gen-dashboard.sh expands this into one folder per service category (agi/app/cloud/data/fin/mic/net/obs/sec/tools) from cloud-data build-flakes_desktop.json's .category field, URL = public domain else internal .app. Replaces the old flat Pub/Priv split.
